create_checkerboard_dataset: create a checkerboard dataset with make_checkerboard using shape, n_clusters, and noise parameters
run_spectral_biclustering: run SpectralBiclustering with n_clusters and method parameters on a shuffled data matrix
test_biclustering_quality: test biclustering quality using consensus_score comparing model results to ground truth labels
build_biclustering_pipeline: build a biclustering pipeline that generates, shuffles, fits, and reorders data with SpectralBiclustering
review_spectral_biclustering: review SpectralBiclustering row_labels_ and column_labels_ to visualize the checkerboard structure
